independent_response_source: GBIF DOI 10.15468/dl.umqmsf; original 225 species candidates, 14,637,152 indexed occurrence rows; no HOSTS source used to construct the response
source_annual_gate: gbif_global224_annual_v1.audit.json source-verified exact row count and 369 official region IDs required
region_scope: Lenzner/WCVP aligned 284 WGSRPD3 level3 areas with >=80% GloNAF geometry and valid climate
primary_region_eligibility: at least 5 globally selected butterflies recorded over 2001-2024, at least 10 datasetKey-date opportunities in 2001-2010 and at least 20 in 2018-2024; fixed before any new regional scoring
dependent_response: Jaccard similarity of 2018-2024 GBIF-detected candidate butterfly species sets; GBIF never used to label true absence
prior_butterfly_response: Jaccard similarity of 2001-2010 recorded butterfly species sets; handle empty pair sets explicitly
model_M0: regional distance and shared world division, temperature and aridity, native flora and native 225-candidate potential resource beta, WCVP flora delta, colonial duration, whole GloNAF alien flora Jaccard/richness, previous GBIF butterfly Jaccard, GBIF dataset/day recording effort in prior/evaluation periods
model_M1: M0 plus documented larval-host GloNAF alien plant Jaccard for source-verified candidate butterflies
model_M2: M0 plus GloNAF alien plant Jaccard not documented as larval hosts for candidate butterflies (not proven nonhosts)
model_M3: M0 plus both documented host and not-documented alien plant Jaccards
model_eval: Ridge lambda=10 standardized on training pairs only; leave-one-region-out mean MSE and MAE, region equal; compare M1/M2/M3 vs M0 and M3 vs M2; clip Jaccard predictions to [0,1]
robustness: leave each entire WGSRPD1 division out with zero held region training outcomes
relaxed and stringent provider-day region gates
negative_control: M2 alien plants not documented as focal hosts; additional family/prevalence-matched control required for strong host-specificity claims
interpretation_limitations: Current WCVP/GloNAF flora may postdate prior/evaluation butterfly records; this is a retrospective association, not a 2018 prospective forecast
Provider-day is unique GBIF datasetKey by ISO record date, not biological survey visits
A region absent from GBIF is not a species absence, and region pairs are dependent
Original 225 species are a selected resource analysis subset, not all butterfly species
No shipping or colonial-era causal pathways can be inferred from these maps
